title: Accessibility audit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for auditing a web page or app against WCAG 2.2 level AA: keyboard paths, focus order and visibility, contrast, text alternatives, captions and transcripts, reflow at 320 CSS pixels, target size, reduced motion, language and landmarks, with every finding citing its success criterion, and tested code for contrast ratios and landmark and heading order.

title: Agent capability and tier firewall
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for enforcing scoped effect ceilings, credential and high-entropy secret redaction, and model data-tier routing guards that block non-public payloads from training or contributor endpoints before dispatch.

title: Agent config supply chain scanner
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for scanning repository agent definitions, rule files, MCP configs, and self-editing memory files for hidden Trojan Unicode, unapproved hook or server escalation, built-in name shadowing, and authority spoofing, with tested standard-library Python code.

title: Agent harness feeds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for continuously researching, benchmarking and encapsulating updates on open agent harnesses (Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code) with HarnessTax token overhead, cost-per-verified-task, Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench normalization, MCP tool reliability, freshness decay and Pareto selection.

title: Annoyance hunt
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for hunting the friction and papercuts people meet, from their point of view: confusing copy, extra clicks, slow steps, surprising defaults, noisy output, repeated prompts, dead ends, inconsistent naming and things that work but feel wrong, with friction tours as charters for websites, command lines, videos and docs, every annoyance recorded in the person's own words with how often it happens, how much it hurts, who it affects and how to reproduce it, ranked by frequency times pain and confirmed by a person.

title: Emerging artifact velocity and curator radar
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for harvesting sanctioned public velocity signals on brand-new open-source repositories, separating runnable engineering substance from star-farming hype, matching curator-lens heuristics, cross-linking existing seed archives without blind duplication, and proposing bounded verification, adapter and demo tasks.

title: Atomic step contract
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for giving each atomic step exactly what it needs: a pinned procedure, a closed slice of state, the last observation and a stated grant, with transcripts left out; grants that deny on the wire rather than in wording; refusals that name what is allowed; state returned as a checked patch; and per-step overhead measured before work is sliced finer.

title: Audio and narration QA
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for deterministic audio, mix and narration quality checks: ITU-R BS.1770-4 gated loudness and 4x oversampled true peak, sidechain pause-pumping detection, edit-point click impulse detection, speaking WPM pacing, WebVTT caption-pause alignment, and ASR Character Error Rate gating.

title: Autonomous DAG stem-cell and answer generalizer
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling tasks (things to do) and task objects across seven Kahn-wave DAG profiles, autonomously lifting discrete decision forks into answer manifolds, vaporizing ephemeral CLI harness workspaces, recovering from canary blueprint drift and computing causal Shapley step credits.

title: Benchmark scores
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for keeping benchmark scores current and comparable: scores with source, date, hardware, setup and method, daily refresh, deterministic staleness flags, checks on our own hardware and a daily schedule proposal that is not activated.

title: Brainstorm chunking and situation miner
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for deduplicating noisy raw notes, chunking unstructured text into content-addressed records, and clustering real-world situations into candidate seed-pack categories, with tested standard-library Python code.

title: Byte latent patch and entropy chunker
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for segmenting byte streams into lossless variable-length patches at conditional Shannon entropy spikes and allocating downstream compute proportional to cumulative information surprise.

title: Capability ontology and benchmark seeds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for polyhierarchical capability and niche ontology graphs, typed AI tool, MCP server, feed and OSS release intelligence cards, durable queue and hackathon radar matrices, multi-axis Pareto benchmarks, root ecosystem seed catalogs and bounded multi-generation seed digestion.

title: Checked data analysis
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for analyzing a CSV file with a check at every step: the file pinned by its digest and its schema profiled, every cell validated against declared types and ranges, missing values and outliers flagged and never silently dropped, summaries and comparisons computed by recorded queries with result digests, charts kept as data specs rather than images, and findings in which every number traces to a query, rechecked by a different worker, while a person decides what the findings mean.

title: Checks of checks
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for proving a test or rubric works before trusting it: checks are run against known-good and known-bad examples, including mutations, with a worked example the validator recomputes.

title: Coconut latent and thought budget routing
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for routing reasoning tasks across four compute regimes, compressing verbose multi-turn traces into continuous latent state plus invariant checkpoints and halting repetitive overthinking cycles.

title: Code composition
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for composing verified code without rewriting it: the tested code itself, a pinned catalog of 18 prewritten code nodes with typed contracts, three declarative recipes with digests measured with that code, and verbs to verify the code, compose, compile, run and compare recipes, and propose new nodes for review.

title: Codebase health review
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a periodic review of a codebase's health at one commit: aging TODO and FIXME comments dated by git blame, error paths no test reaches, swallowed exceptions, logging noise, dependency drift and unpinned or stale versions, flaky tests, oversized modules, duplicated code, docs that drift from the code and secrets hygiene reported by place and pattern only, with tested code for the TODO ager and the swallowed-exception finder, a report that gives every area its own status and no single score, and every item that needs action recorded as a finding.

title: Coding session trace distiller
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for mining sanitized multi-hour AI coding session JSONL transcripts into reusable failure tombstones, tool-error loops, verified fix recipes, and prompt-shim candidates, with tested standard-library Python code.

title: Combinatorial niche spider
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for combinatorial multi-domain niche-cell forging, page-cursor coverage ledgers, persistent BFS spider frontiers, purposeful refresh for movers and 404 rot, bounded multi-wave follow-up proposals and 8-axis candidate evaluation with query-family yield benchmarks.

title: Configuration grids and bounds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for declarative multi-dimensional configuration grids, runtime parameter clamping, verified cell lifecycles, contextual regime selection, saturated boundary auto-expansion and AST magic-literal gates.

title: Continuous self-review
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for reviewing a repository, site or video on a rotation, run after run: scopes with the checks each needs from other packs, a schedule that stays a proposal until a person approves it, the next scopes picked by a fixed rule from what was reviewed least recently or changed most, each run's findings diffed against the last run into new, still open, fixed, unverified, unexplained, unchecked and reopened, fixes verified by a different worker, a review log that shows coverage over time, and a self-review before any change is handed on.

title: Continuous tuning
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for tuning a small open model at one narrow task, round after round, and keeping a change only when a rule committed before any scoring says so: owned made-up examples, curation against contamination, a frozen test registered by its hashes, a QLoRA or LoRA adapter trained on free or local GPUs, strict exact-match evaluation with a paired bootstrap, a reload check, a recomputable decision, and a private champion pointer that moves or stays.

title: Cost optimization
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for finding and measuring cost savings: ledgers from supplied usage and dated prices, savings proposed with arithmetic, before-and-after measurements and recommendations for the owner, keeping billed, measured, estimated and credit apart.

title: Declarative chart and diagram SVG
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling structured data tables and component message traces into publication-grade accessible SVGs (confidence-interval forest plots, progression bars, and edge-packet diagrams) with deterministic WCAG contrast and label-collision checks.

title: Decomposition patterns
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for breaking work into verbs with reusable patterns: nine patterns, each with a null-honest success record, and verbs to propose breakdowns, try alternatives as separate attempts, compare them by downstream outcomes and record what worked.

title: Deep research report
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for answering a research question with a cited report: a framed question, a search plan that looks for evidence against the answer, sources collected through permitted access and screened with recorded reasons, claims with exact quotes and locators, a synthesis with every sentence labeled, an adversarial review by a different worker, and a report that states its limits and what was not searched; for understanding a question, not for choosing what to build.

title: Docs improvement

title: DoRA, SpinQuant and adapter merging
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for Walsh-Hadamard outlier rotation quantization, weight-decomposed low-rank adapter analysis and subspace interference routing across static fusion and co-resident switching.

summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for inspecting every frame of an encoded video with nine deterministic computer-vision detectors and UI region masks: cut-off content and windows, overlapping text and callout chips, small text at 1080p and phone width, transitions and double exposures, freezes and fast text motion, caption collisions, contrast ratios, layered edge spill, and UI control occlusions, clustered into annotated findings with seeded human precision review.

title: Handwritten statements to text kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for turning handwritten statements and forms dropped into a folder into text typed exactly as written, keeping the writer's slang, spelling, acronyms and words, flagging every uncertain reading for a person, and listing acronyms against a local glossary, while staff check every flag, follow up on safety, sign off and decide any use.

title: Policy research brief kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a small nonprofit's policy research brief: a new public rule or ordinance summarized in plain language with a citation to the clause behind every point, quotes checked against the official text, and open questions where the text is unclear, while what a rule means for the organization or any person, and anything shared publicly, stays with staff and counsel.

title: Victim support referral kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a victim services program's referral kit: referral options drafted from a public services directory by service type, language, hours and access needs, and a plain referral checklist, while every conversation, safety step, decision and contact stays with trained advocates and nothing accuses anyone.

title: Volunteer shift schedule kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a disaster relief hub's volunteer shift schedule: registered volunteers matched to posted tasks by skills, availability and recorded training, and one-page site briefings, while placements, site safety and every message to volunteers stay with the coordinator and site lead.

title: Launch readiness

summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for inert window-keyed schedule compilation, fragility half-life urgency ranking, AIMD claim pacing, UCB1 anti-stall bandit loops, seven-tier compute resource cascades and six advice-only swappable learners.

title: Public company research

summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for user acceptance testing: made-up personas with goals, acceptance criteria a person agrees to before any test, scenario scripts, observed results recorded as they happen, every defect proposed as a finding, and a person's go or no-go kept as a noun.

title: Video editing
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for editing a video from its script: an edit decision list, a cut paced against the words spoken over it, J and L cuts, b-roll placement, transitions, colour and contrast consistency, an audio mix with ducking and loudness targets, reframing for other aspect ratios, and a conform and export spec, with every revision kept and a person locking the cut.

title: Video and motion with code
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for video and motion made with code: tested code shipped in the pack and pinned by digest, scene recipes, a procedural asset catalog, motion formulas, aspect, caption and audio rules, every-frame and post-encode checks, a demo sequence, media and tool cards, with verbs to seek frames, fit motion, draft, compile and check scenes, and plan, render and check a video.

title: Video QA checks
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for automated checks on an encoded video beyond the eight post-encode checks: blank and frozen frames, cut cadence, loudness range and true peak, clipping and silence gaps, caption timing against speech, caption line length and reading speed, safe areas, the file's delivery spec read from its own boxes, and a legibility proxy for rendered text, each measured on the exact bytes with tested standard-library code.

title: Video review
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for reviewing a video with a fixed rubric, run by a person or a worker that did not make it: panels of the exact bytes at the sizes people watch on, every number traced to its evidence, timestamped findings with a severity, the evidence seen and the verb that would fix each one, a second opinion where reviewers disagree, a person who watches and listens, and a re-review of the fixed cut.

title: Video showcase
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for making a truthful demo video: script, storyboard, shot list, capture plan, audio cue sheet, styles, captions, evidence links and showcase checks, with verbs from script to review and the owner's publication record; scenes, assembly, rendering and encoded-video checks use the video and motion pack.

title: Video audience acceptance
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for testing whether a video's intended viewers understand it: named audience segments, video-specific tasks such as saying what it does after one viewing, pass criteria fixed before any session, consented sessions a person runs, answers scored by two scorers, a decision that never generalizes beyond the people asked, and every miss turned into a finding about the cut.

title: Visual and 3D rendering
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for rendering images, motion graphics and 3D scenes and checking the results: renderer cards, scene, asset and motion recipes, quality checks with a contrast worked example, and verbs to plan, prepare, render, check and review.

title: Voice narration
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for narration with a text-to-speech voice: a pronunciation lexicon applied before synthesis and confirmed by ear, seeded takes logged with the exact text the model received, loudness, peak, noise-floor and pace measurements with a round-trip transcript check, takes chosen by a rule fixed in advance, lines placed on the beats they must fit, a person's listening check, and an AI-voice label wherever the voice plays.

title: Website-first walkthrough capture
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for checking website-first walkthrough shot lists and generating deterministic browser recorder plans in the v6 capture window (1280x613 CSS px at device scale 1.5) with real surface hosts, take ids, request-band anchors, 1.8 s minimum shots, reading-speed holds, no status stamps and zero camera drift.

title: Wiring and conformance checks
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for proving that a code project's capabilities are wired in: modules no live path imports, config fields that do not survive a save and reload, health probes that probe nothing, a canary for every rule so a check that stops firing is noticed, and documented behaviors whose only tests replace the real path with a mock; every gap recorded as a finding in the findings to fixes shape, with tested standard-library code that finds unused modules, mock-only tests and hollow probes in Python packages.
